docs.title: Material Deck Starfinder Documentation
docs.text:
Material Deck Starfinder Documentation

This documentation is for the Starfinder system module for Material Deck. Please refer to the Material Deck documentation for more info on Material Deck.

The Material Deck Starfinder system module adds Starfinder-dependent features to Material Deck to the following actions:

  • Combat Tracker
  • Other Actions
  • Token

docs.title: Combatibility
docs.text:
Tested on: Foundry VTT: v13-v14 Starfinder: v0.28

Requires Material Deck v2.2.0+.

docs.title: Changelog
docs.text:
Changes between module versions are documented here. This changelog is for v2+ only, for the pre v2 changelog click here.

v2.0.0 - 14-05-2025

Made compatible with Material Deck v2

docs.title: Combat Tracker Action
docs.text: The 'Combat Tracker' action has new Stats, On Press and On Hold options. These options are identical to the ones for the Token Mode of the 'Token' action.

docs.title: Set Default Roll Mode
docs.text: Using this function you can change the 'default roll mode'. This roll mode is applied to rolls in the Token Action if their Roll Mode is set to Default.

docs.title: Mode
docs.text:
You can configure a button to set the mode to:

  • Description: Display a description of the item/feature/spell in the chat
  • Use/Cast: Perform a roll to use a feature or cast a spell
  • Attack: Perform an attack roll
  • Damage: Perform a damage roll

docs.title: Set After Use To
docs.text:
With this setting you can configure what the default roll mode should be set to after performing a roll. For example, you might want it to always default tattack rolls, so you set it to Attack. If you have multiple 'Set Default Roll Mode' buttons on the display, their Set After Use To setting will be the same for all.

Set After Use To is only applied when something is rolled that actually uses the default roll mode.

docs.title: Token Action
docs.text:
The token action has extra features for the Token mode, and adds new modes:

  • Token Mode: New Stats, On Press and On Hold options
  • Inventory Mode: Display and roll weapons and other items
  • Features Mode: Display and roll actor features
  • Spellbook Mode: Display and roll spells

All modes also have the Wound Overlay functionality.

docs.title: Token Mode
docs.text:
The Token mode has new Stats, On Press and On Hold options.

Option Description Stats Stat to display:-HP-Temporary HP-Stamina-Energy AC-Kinetic AC-Movement Speed-Initiative-Spellcasting: Spellcasting ability or spell slots.-Currency: All, or a specified type of currency.-Ability Score: Ability score of a specified ability.-Ability Modifier: Ability modifier of a specified ability.-Save: Saving throw bonus of a specified ability.-Skill Ranks: Skill rank of a specified skill.-Skill Modifier: Modifier score of a specified skill.-XP: Experience points On Press/On Hold Sets what to do when the button is pressed/held down:-Toggle Condition: Toggle a specified condition or clear all conditions.-Dice Roll: Roll a dice for a specified feature.

docs.title: Dice Roll
docs.text:
Dice Roll allows you to roll a dice for the selected token/actor.

Option Description Roll Type of roll:-Initiative: Roll initiative (if in combat).-Ability: Roll an ability check.-Save: Roll a saving throw.-Skill Check: Roll a skill check. Ability(Ability Check &Saving Throw) Ability to roll. Skill(Skill Check) Skill to roll.

docs.title: Inventory Mode
docs.text:
The inventory mode can be used to display and control items in the token/actor's inventory.

Option Description Item Type -Item: Select the type of item to display, or select 'Any' for all items.-Set Type & Filter Sync: Set the synced settings for this page. Will synchronize Item Type and Selection Filter.-Offset: Set item offsets. Selection Filter Selects item parameters to filter out, such as unequipped or identified items. Sync Type & Filter Will synchronize Item Type and Selection Filter for all buttons on this page with this setting enabled. Selection Set how to select the item:-Select by Nr: Select an item using a number.-Select by Name/Id: Select an item using its name or id. Order(Select by Nr) Sets how to order the items:-Character Sheet: Follow the order of the character sheet.-Alphabetically: Order items alphabetically. Nr(Select by Nr) Number of the item to select. Name/Id(Select by Name/Id) Name or id of the item to select. On Press/On Hold Sets what to do when the button is pressed/held down:-Do Nothing: Do nothing.-Use: Use (roll) the item.-Equip: Equip or unequip the item. Roll Mode(Use) Roll mode:-Default: Roll using the default roll mode-Description: Display a description of the item in the chat-Use/Cast: Perform a roll to use item-Attack: Perform an attack roll-Damage: Perform a damage roll Mode(Equip) Configure what to do:-Toggle: Toggle between equipping and unequipping item.-Equip: Equip item.-Unequip: Unequip item. Display -Icon: Display item's icon.-Name: Display item's name.-Box: Display a box with data.

docs.title: Features Mode
docs.text:
The features mode can be used to display and control token/actor features.

Option Description Features Type -Feature: Select the type of feature to display, or select 'Any' for all features.-Set Type Sync: Set the synced settings for this page. Will synchronize Feature Type and Feature Type Filter.-Offset: Set feature offsets. Sync Type Will synchronize Feature Type for all buttons on this page with this setting enabled. Selection Set how to select the feature:-Select by Nr: Select a feature using a number.-Select by Name/Id: Select a feature using its name or id. Order(Select by Nr) Sets how to order the features:-Character Sheet: Follow the order of the character sheet.-Alphabetically: Order features alphabetically. Nr(Select by Nr) Number of the feature to select. Name/Id(Select by Name/Id) Name or id of the feature to select. On Press/On Hold Sets what to do when the button is pressed/held down:-Do Nothing: Do nothing.-Use: Use (roll) the item.-Equip: Equip or unequip the item. Roll Mode(Use) Roll mode:-Default: Roll using the default roll mode-Description: Display a description of the feature in the chat-Use/Cast: Perform a roll to use the feature-Attack: Perform an attack roll-Damage: Perform a damage roll Display -Icon: Display feature's icon.-Name: Display feature's name.

docs.title: Spellbook Mode
docs.text:
The spellbook mode can be used to display and control token/actor spells.

Option Description Spell Type -Level: Select the level of the spell to select from, or select 'Any' for all spells.-Set Type Sync: Set the synced settings for this page. Will synchronize Spell Type.-Offset: Set item offsets. Sync Type Will synchronize Spell Type for all buttons on this page with this setting enabled. Selection Set how to select the spell:-Select by Nr: Select a spell using a number.-Select by Name/Id: Select a spell using its name or id. Order(Select by Nr) Sets how to order the spells:-Character Sheet: Follow the order of the character sheet.-Alphabetically: Order spells alphabetically. Nr(Select by Nr) Number of the spell to select. Name/Id(Select by Name/Id) Name or id of the spell to select. On Press/On Hold Sets what to do when the button is pressed/held down:-Do Nothing: Do nothing.-Cast Spell: Cast the spell. Roll Mode(Use) Roll mode:-Default: Roll using the default roll mode-Description: Display a description of the spell in the chat-Use/Cast: Perform a roll as a cast-Attack: Perform an attack roll-Damage: Perform a damage roll Display -Icon: Display spell's icon.-Name: Display spell's name.-Slots: Display the spell's slots.

docs.title: Synced Settings
docs.text:
You can synchronize setting across multiple buttons on the same page, where a page is all the buttons that are currently visible on the device. If two buttons have Sync Type & Filter selected, and you change one of the filter settings on one, the otheer button will also be changed.

Each of the modes have a Set Type & Filter Sync setting. If you press this button, all buttons with Syn Type & Filter will have their settings changed to what you have configured for the Set Type & Filter Sync button.

docs.title: Offset
docs.text:
Offsets can be used in combination with the Select by Nr Selection Mode. By setting an offset, you increase Nr for all buttons with that offset.

For example, say you have 9 Inventory Mode buttons, with Nr set from 1 to 9. If you then set the offset to 9, it will display items 10 - 19.

Option Description Offset Mode Sets how to set the offset:-Set to Value: Sets the offset to the value set in Offset.-Increase/Decrease: Increases the offset by the value set in Offset. Offset The value to set the offset to (in case of Set to Value), or the value to increment the offset with (in case of Increase/Decrease). The offset can be any value, positive or negative. Display -Offset: Display the current offset on the Stream Deck.-Icon: Display an icon on the Stream Deck. Colors -On Color: (Set to Value only) A border is drawn on the Stream Deck of this color if the current offset is equal to the offset configured in Offset.-Off Color: (Set to Value only) A border is drawn on the Stream Deck of this color if the current offset is not equal to the offset configured in Offset.-Background: Background color of the button.

docs.title: Wound Overlay
docs.text:
Wound overlays can give the approximate health state of a token. For example, based on how much relative HP a token has it can overlay one or more blood drops over the token icon:

HP Percentage Overlay 76% - 100% No overlay 51% - 75% 1 Droplets 26% - 50% 2 Droplets 1% - 25% 3 Droplets 0 Skull overlay

This can be useful if you want to give players an overview of a token's health, without giving the actual HP.

Wound overlays are available in all Token Modes.

Option Description Wound Overlay Sets the overlay type. Opacity Sets the opacity of the overlay, with 0 being fully transparant and 1 being fully opaque. Color Sets the color of the overlay.
